voice_086:r_479b340ccc6c572b.text: My job is to blaze a trail onward!

voice_086:r_ca4acbac57a2a35e.text: No holding back! Let's go all out!

voice_086:r_70b9c4b9f1f37eff.text: Dig and dig till I break through!

voice_086:r_9fcb3754cb1773c7.text: Each turn of the drill moves us on!

voice_086:r_3559d2fad32c2435.text: Defy reason and kick logic aside!

voice_086:r_cbab0f4720e1fcf1.text: I'll bore right through your body!

voice_086:r_5dda5198137cb02a.text: Who says this ends in one shot?!

voice_086:r_83ec59afbecdec14.text: No! No! No! No! Not yet!

voice_086:r_6dbcc507fb61b51d.text: A Gundam, huh?!\nI'll take you on!

voice_086:r_0121a166c715cdff.text: I'll take care of that monster!

voice_086:r_30fad37a42bd3ad3.text: Like I'd let a monster run loose!

voice_086:r_4a9ac1dff86506d9.text: Huge or not,\nmy drill won't stop!

voice_086:r_9e0c80ac7e33b459.text: Thanks for earlier! This is payback!

voice_086:r_7432ef43ed3471dc.text: Where do you think you're going?!

voice_086:r_065443f6ddfcf0d7.text: You picked this fight! Bring it!

voice_086:r_55417493fce1d347.text: Yoko's someone I can really rely on!

voice_086:r_24cf161287ef9d5c.text: Leave the rest to me, Ryoma!

voice_086:r_8f60f6fc86db3107.text: Want my friends? Beat me first!

voice_086:r_620fedec67706d7d.text: Put more spirit into it, Gimmy!

voice_086:r_9680dcd0fddcfcc7.text: Darry, fall back and support us!

voice_086:r_2a00f1044ad5cbaa.text: I'll show Ryoma what I'm made of!

voice_086:r_3dbeead1bd3164ef.text: I'll be sure to repay you later!

voice_086:r_98d15b8cc09bc915.text: I'll spare you once! Never again!

voice_086:r_cdbd128a5b4127cc.text: What the hell are you aiming at?!

voice_086:r_cfccaa1fbeda124c.text: You didn't even graze me! Try again!

voice_086:r_b1f8ec192b9c083a.text: So weak,\na fly could land on it!

voice_086:r_de1213040856c089.text: I'll knock it back with the barrier!

voice_086:r_0c0775e051211840.text: Someone like you can't beat me!

voice_086:r_a2afffe1c396f0b3.text: Hit me a thousand times harder!

voice_086:r_9cedad8237480563.text: I don't give up!\nThat's how I live!

voice_086:r_a554ceef5c87b972.text: Hey! How will you split the power?!

voice_086:r_2c9d94ba13c5fc50.text: Heh... I can't afford to slip up!

voice_086:r_428c2116ac3071b1.text: Good, Viral! That's more like it!

voice_086:r_dad38ee29af2df3a.text: So this is Gurren Lagann's power!

voice_086:r_3d32e86f8dc80909.text: I'm no sidekick...\nBut I'll do it!

voice_086:r_69dfa1659715e2fa.text: They're no match for Gurren Lagann!

voice_086:r_d996fd6d4ef5b329.text: Even if you look like Gurren Lagann!

voice_086:r_8ab47a28f99ef565.text: You're a fake! Show the real power!

voice_086:r_1252db29683fefe0.text: You won't let them escape, will you?

voice_086:r_ad3d538f1e909184.text: Of course. We'll pay them back!

voice_086:r_b84afafb8a33ec60.text: We'll have to bide our time for now!

voice_086:r_fa944da4b6519006.text: Looks like I didn't need to pilot!

voice_086:r_95d047bcc17fccc6.text: That's Simon! A man I acknowledge!

voice_086:r_bdd38c584fa313d0.text: Don't ask the obvious! Get going!

voice_086:r_3fd86c1027f317c8.text: Good! Keep drawing the enemy in!

voice_086:r_d0372a183d2007ad.text: Quit dawdling! Hurry and crush them!

voice_086:r_f1e7ed9e5874aba5.text: Seems you haven't lost your touch!

voice_086:r_774a9ab4d8fd5351.text: Hey, don't say that! It's useful!

voice_086:r_d3f01de714c015bd.text: Now that is some impressive armor!

voice_086:r_7d2617c809fead70.text: I've felt how tough this thing is!

voice_086:r_ceb935ccbf830724.text: You think that can stop me?!

voice_086:r_862ef7385bf2abd4.text: Hmph! This is so easy, I'm bored!

voice_086:r_26e5efec03c03d78.text: So there was no need to dodge.

voice_086:r_0bad405ee6ca63ba.text: Just focus on defeating the enemy!

voice_086:r_b28faf9f71bc3598.text: You said it!\nSee my hidden strength!

voice_086:r_edd7a13ab8f06a14.text: I know! Gurren Lagann won't lose!

voice_086:r_8165e5b41f0124c4.text: Would Gurren Lagann lose to a fake?!

voice_086:r_4e05581b7432cce8.text: Take the cut...!\nNow the real fight!

voice_086:r_0a3fccb71ec6cf2a.text: Even if it looks like Gurren Lagann!

voice_086:r_38e4a434c91d8ef0.text: A bad joke!\nI won't turn my back!

voice_086:r_98ed411352a3a6ac.text: Heh...! Who do you think I am?!

voice_086:r_57b2bd2de8a1408d.text: This is bad! The machine won't last!

voice_086:r_76f080a4881e8ab5.text: Fine!\nWe'll win before we burn out!

voice_086:r_288133bc5b573dae.text: Damn it...! Did I really lose?!

voice_086:r_e9b3307e9eb69f11.text: Sorry, Viral... This is my limit...

voice_086:r_ec1081caf845f56a.text: Game over! Do that move, Viral!

voice_086:r_eb5f687fcd372ae7.text: What do you think this game is?!

voice_086:r_2329428a6871d9fa.text: Same old thing, so I won't ask...

voice_086:r_0e7466971bec4cc4.text: Nice work! Rest, then play again!

voice_086:r_efa71f7a4cc33ff3.text: Hope and despair twist at the end!

voice_086:r_3fc2e1186557e7a0.text: Robots unite! Super Robot Wars Z3!

voice_086:r_0bc8ae32a406ceab.text: Let's strike the one straight ahead!

voice_086:r_d520c6d5298a848d.text: Which attack will take them down?!

voice_086:r_bece29562818acba.text: Man and beast twist into one spiral!

voice_086:r_a4a5a96f4bd58920.text: Who the hell do you think I am?!

voice_086:r_b57d2d74233f889a.text: Past foes break fate, take tomorrow!

voice_086:r_e54e2c99ef8297af.text: The hopes left behind open the door!

voice_086:r_f16a3eb0bcaac082.text: Though endless space blocks our way!

voice_086:r_10a408809e512df1.text: Our boiling blood will decide fate!

voice_086:r_96b21e3a028dd074.text: Who the hell do you think we are?!

voice_086:r_ce140b5d8e6b7310.text: Who the hell do you think we are?!

voice_086:r_2d7a9c06347582d9.text: Dayakka will make a good father!

voice_086:r_e09b933e3e706779.text: Hold fast!\nFirst to back down loses!

voice_086:r_9639a2dbcd2f58ed.text: You couldn't hit me in a lifetime!

voice_086:r_aeea0893acb93d35.text: You can't beat this thing like that!

voice_086:r_fa07d90fca62f593.text: What a cocky bastard! Crush them!

voice_086:r_237a0288b42dce20.text: First things first - land a hit!

voice_086:r_0556e8a22779ea8e.text: Hmph! Get those stinking feet away!

voice_086:r_8b18aa4cc69547df.text: Pierce past and future at once!

voice_086:r_af62f2ee466b5c8c.text: A weapon this big begs to be used!

voice_086:r_60c94ea4eb7f7404.text: I'll leave this to you, Dayakka!

voice_086:r_727b2ee0277f9159.text: Yeah! You can count on me!

voice_086:r_79e0d542fe12bcf7.text: Yeah! I'll show a man's mettle!

voice_086:r_b2dc77aa6dd77e69.text: My wife's the best in the universe!

voice_086:r_445d40d8b5d7092b.text: Then we'll just fire like crazy!

voice_086:r_f4ff463b2fda1b86.text: Yes... No matter how hard it is...!

voice_086:r_795ed21f3e28e1f5.text: My thanks... to this shifting fate!

voice_086:r_638834e16724002f.text: I'll say it as often as it takes...!

voice_086:r_b02fca1590ac1210.text: Who do you think we are, huh?!

voice_086:r_49734bdb3507acf7.text: Here's where I show my skill!

voice_086:r_6823f8abe05c4727.text: All right! Who wants a hole first?!

voice_086:r_c885ff2097749991.text: Cover me, Viral! I'm counting on it!

voice_086:r_197f05bf899b7697.text: We can do this too!\nWe'll show them!

voice_086:r_c5c491f8761152f0.text: We eat after this! Keep it up!

voice_086:r_96b3a8f080aea8b4.text: This is the soul of Team Dai-Gurren!

voice_086:r_3d4fa015b8b31648.text: I'll slam that soul's fire into you!

voice_086:r_8a303240a87b1c7d.text: We'll sweep them all away at once!

voice_086:r_aeb9079d86e2a924.text: I can count on you, Lordgenome!

voice_086:r_bc4658630f8e40a9.text: First, let's hit them with a blast!

voice_086:r_2835a8af1c41be9b.text: Anyone in our way gets blown aside!

voice_086:r_0465f74c0488ad70.text: I'll take them all out at once!

voice_086:r_0be18539fac21ba4.text: My drill will pierce your despair!

voice_086:r_f69a0e1d0d67fd0e.text: Shinji! Show me you're a man!

voice_086:r_7ecfe7ddfa4cdb6a.text: Asuka! Don't get scared and cry!

voice_086:r_e0022ae8da32f998.text: While we stand, the world won't end!

voice_086:r_0ef83b6a1e87f6fd.text: Even an A.T. Field\nmeets my drill!

voice_086:r_a8f0666c4d6d24a0.text: Even against you, I go all out...!

voice_086:r_3ec7c6e48027a853.text: I'm going all out, Captain Quattro!

voice_086:r_953824ba6b607e1f.text: I'll stop it and set you free!

voice_086:r_d6c7a401f55ee42f.text: Can't you see?\nNo time for war!

voice_086:r_97b5fedc5b19e6af.text: Haven't you had enough war yet?!

voice_086:r_10cb1d3f8f325f52.text: I'll blast you back to your planet!

voice_086:r_82e0a318411dcbf7.text: A Black Hole\nwon't eat my drill!

voice_086:r_36c402609f13ec14.text: Whoever you are, I'm taking a swing!

voice_086:r_5ec6634ac287489a.text: Whoever you are,\nI do what I do!

voice_086:r_0f6c6e8f33422ecf.text: If words fail, my fists will speak!

voice_086:r_035b4f6912ba7eed.text: If talk fails, I've got to do this!

voice_086:r_ae913eb08e0ff29b.text: You seem fit\nto lead after all!

voice_086:r_46e80691278d2e90.text: Your rule from the top\nends here!

voice_086:r_c4c8af04ee11993c.text: Last one! I'll spin my drill dry!

voice_086:r_ef1ca3b6b4a983b9.text: I'll crush you filthy scum head-on!

voice_086:r_58fa3a0d2bd59f45.text: This blow breaks sky and dimensions!

voice_086:r_248e2e68f66891d5.text: Rei! Leave the rest to me!

voice_086:r_dc569fdc0d6c30a3.text: Asuka! I'll show you how it's done!

voice_086:r_e58eebaa984b6a93.text: I can't let Noriko outdo me!

voice_086:r_75727ed69511d963.text: You dig a mean hole as ever, Andy!

voice_086:r_366a1594371ae41a.text: Rei! Take better care of yourself!

voice_086:r_814dde2abac39def.text: No one hurts a fellow digger!

voice_086:r_add28b5abd18497e.text: Don't push yourself too hard, Ox!

voice_086:r_29b7ea4092df4b1b.text: Your precious EVA is crying, Asuka!

voice_086:r_7eb1ff91e6dd4579.text: Asuka! Is that all you've got?!

voice_086:r_c3e2c2524e6af617.text: That attack will put me to sleep!

voice_086:r_c33c630320a0f42d.text: So weak,\nyou can't even scratch me!

voice_086:r_7e84498103e0d8e2.text: Sorry, but that's a wasted effort.

voice_086:r_857d69cc06534ed0.text: So reckless! You don't get women!

voice_086:r_abadc65ae19c6a47.text: I've got plenty to say, but later!

voice_086:r_35d7693142bfac0c.text: Heh...!\nSee? You can do it, Shinji!

voice_086:r_bbce9cc348b5fec2.text: Yes, Rei! Put your soul in the blow!

voice_086:r_6a33536cdb9e9c32.text: Close, Asuka! Just one more push!

voice_086:r_1f7722403476a2d4.text: This is fun! A worthy foe at last!

voice_086:r_1d33f9b6c6e83560.text: Whoa! I never expected this much!

voice_086:r_25da1b11fada0cea.text: I always fight at full power!
